payload.definition: Traditional joke structure with a setup that establishes context and a punchline that delivers the humor payoff.
payload.inclusion_criteria: Clear two-part structure: setup line(s) followed by a distinct punchline.
payload.exclusion_criteria: One-liner observations or statements without a distinct setup-punchline separation.
examples: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
A man tells his doctor, 'Help me. I'm addicted to Twitter!' The doctor replies, 'Sorry, I don't follow you.'
counter_examples: I'm reading a book on the history of glue – can't put it down. (Single statement, no setup-punchline structure)
